segments.source_text: Thermal annealing at 100 C for 10 min improved the crystallinity of perovskite films [1].
segments.target_text: 在 100 C 下退火 10 min 改善了钙钛矿薄膜的结晶度 [1]。

evidence.quote: Thermal annealing at 100 C for 10 min improved the crystallinity of perovskite films [1].

segments.source_text: The annealed films retained 95% of initial efficiency after 500 h, versus 70% for controls [2,3].
segments.target_text: 退火后的薄膜在 500 h 后保留了初始效率的 95%，而对照组为 70% [2,3]。

evidence.quote: The annealed films retained 95% of initial efficiency after 500 h, versus 70% for controls [2,3].

segments.source_text: We conclude that moderate annealing improves stability under the tested conditions.
segments.target_text: 我们得出结论：在所测试的条件下，适度退火可改善稳定性。

evidence.quote: We conclude that moderate annealing improves stability under the tested conditions.
